en.io: Input: project directory, feature ID, acceptance criteria, validation rules, and related tests. Output: pass state, evidence per criterion, test summary, timestamp, and state update.
en.boundary: Manual criteria still require human or external measurement. The source declares pass state as one-way false-to-true, which means later regressions are not represented by that state model. Implementation and command-sandbox behavior are not included.
dependencies: Project test, lint, typecheck, and coverage tools
scenarios: Determine whether an implemented feature passes.
Check test, lint, typecheck, and coverage requirements.

zh.io: 输入：项目目录、功能 ID、验收标准、验证规则和相关测试。输出：通过状态、逐标准证据、测试摘要、时间戳和状态更新。
zh.boundary: 人工标准仍需人或外部测量。来源规定 passes 只能从 false 变 true，因此后续回归无法由该状态模型表达；实现细节和命令隔离行为未提供。
dependencies: 项目测试、lint、类型检查和覆盖率工具
scenarios: 判断已实现功能是否通过。
检查测试、lint、类型检查和覆盖率要求。
